title: The relayed decider-mismatch error escapes both names
description: The relayed decider-mismatch error escapes both names
no_spec_change_rationale: Makes the decider-mismatch error match REQ-cmd-change-relayed-decision-001, whose text output escapes control characters in recorded names and relayed fields; the error printed both names raw.
acceptance_criteria: The decider-mismatch error, on write (change approve or review with a relay) and on read (change status, show and every ledger read), shows the relayed decided_by and the record's actor or reviewer with control characters escaped, so a stored escape sequence or newline is printed as its escape (red then green)
